name: Weather Notice Delivery
description: Per (warning id x recipient) delivery-assurance ledger for severe-weather notices. TENANT-side doctype. kind=subscriber rows are written by the hourly push-sync job when a push is handed to the comms sender, upgraded by the ack_weather_notice endpoint (opened beats seen beats delivered), and stamped by the SMS fallback job (send-once). kind=escalation rows record one escalation-ladder step per notified Weather Escalation Contact; their tokened acknowledge link acks via ack_weather_escalation and stops the ladder. Admin-only; aggregated by get_weather_notice_stats. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: subscriber = a pushed end user; escalation = a Weather Escalation Contact notified by the escalation ladder

fields.label: Warning ID
fields.description: Control-side Severe Weather Warning record name carried in the push payload (the tenant shell has no warning records to link to)

fields.label: Severity (internal enum)
fields.description: Internal machine identifier (heads_up/warning) - never shown to end users

fields.label: Escalation Priority
fields.description: The contact's rung on the ladder at notification time

fields.label: Channels Used
fields.description: Comma-separated channels the escalation step actually reached (e.g. push,email,sms)

fields.label: SMS Sent At (UTC)
fields.description: Send-once mark of the SMS fallback (set even when the gateway send failed - repeat spam is worse than a lost transient)

fields.label: Acked Event
fields.description: Highest acknowledgment event so far - upgrade-only (opened beats seen beats delivered)

fields.label: First Seen At (UTC)
fields.description: First time the ack ladder reached at least seen - the timestamp behind the median-minutes-to-seen stat

fields.label: Client Timestamp (UTC)
fields.description: Client-claimed timestamp from the ack payload; informational only, server clocks rule the metrics

fields.label: Ack Token
fields.description: Opaque token of the escalation acknowledge link (kind=escalation rows only)
